name: Talking To The Dead
overview: Scripture clearly forbids seeking communication with the dead or consulting familiar spirits, identifying such practices as abominations that defile and provoke God's judgment (Leviticus 19:31; Deuteronomy 18:10-12). The Bible teaches that the dead are silent and inactive, incapable of praising the Lord or knowing anything, emphasizing the futility and error of necromancy (Psalms 115:17; Ecclesiastes 9:5). Believers are called to trust in the living God rather than turn to occult practices that contradict His holiness and authority.
